question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**scoot**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the third blank is '**scoot**'.
 
• **Scoot**: Slide in a sitting position.(दौड़ना)
 
 
• Example: She laughed when she saw me scooting down the slope on my backside.
 
 
 
• Hummingbirds cannot walk or hop on the ground, but they can use their feet to scoot or shuffle sideways while perched. This allows them to adjust their position or move along a perch without having to fly.
 
• **Perched **- (of a bird) alight or rest on something.
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other options:
 
 
• "**Migrate**" means to move from one place to another, especially in a seasonal pattern;(बस जाना)
 
• "**obtrude**" means to become noticeable or to force oneself or one's opinions on others;(निकालना)
 
• "**forage**" means to search for food or provisions, especially by digging or browsing.(ख़ुराक)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
